title: Morning Brief - Prem
intro_md: Type "more on G3" (or any code) here, or tap More info on the brief page and paste the request here, and I'll dig into it.

items.headline_md: US forces **disable a Palau-flagged ship, the Pacific Archer**, that CENTCOM says tried to breach the **Iran blockade** in the Gulf of Oman
items.summary_md: An aircraft hit its stern with precision munitions after it ignored warnings; the crew was unharmed, and Iranian officials vowed to confront the blockade.

items.headline_md: Update: **Kuwait summons Iran's ambassador** over the drone strike that killed two Italians, and **Italy** will lodge a complaint
items.summary_md: Italy's foreign minister says the drone was Iranian-made; Iran denies launching it and offers a joint investigation.

items.headline_md: **Taiwan votes in local elections today** after **30 Chinese military aircraft** patrolled nearby Friday, 26 crossing the median line
items.summary_md: About 19.65 million people can vote; the Taipei mayor race and a nuclear-power referendum are the main contests (One Turn).

items.headline_md: **Ukraine proposes a Black Sea ceasefire** and awaits Russia's reply, after Russian drones hit energy and rail in **nine regions**
items.summary_md: Ukraine halted all electricity exports after the strikes and a cold snap (Argus).

items.headline_md: **New Zealand's final count gives a hung parliament**: the National-led coalition has 65 seats, one short of a majority
items.summary_md: Opposition parties won 58 seats, raising the possibility of another election.

items.headline_md: Update: **400,000+ US customers are still without power** after the Thanksgiving storm, with **Missouri** among the three hardest-hit states
items.summary_md: Pennsylvania leads with 99,317 outages, then New Jersey and Missouri, per PowerOutage.us; Virginia declared a state of emergency.

items.headline_md: **Houthi media say a Saudi airstrike killed 11 people**, mostly children, in Yemen's Taiz
items.summary_md: Saudi air defenses also downed a Houthi cruise missile fired at Riyadh (One Turn).

items.headline_md: **Altria** is weighing an all-cash bid for **Imperial Brands** (worth about **$34 billion**), possibly with Japan Tobacco
items.summary_md: It would be the tobacco sector's biggest deal in nearly a decade.

items.headline_md: **China's industrial profits jumped 20% in October**, but retail sales rose just **0.4%**
items.summary_md: Beijing then pledged more state-fund market support, and the Shanghai Composite rose 3.73%, its biggest gain in about two years (Argus).

items.headline_md: **OPEC+** has reportedly agreed in principle to **hold Q1 2027 output targets** at its Nov. 29 meeting
items.summary_md: Brent settled down 1.2% at $95.44 on Nov. 27, per Reuters sources cited by Argus.

items.headline_md: UK discount chain **Poundland goes into administration**, with closures and job losses expected
items.summary_md: About 2,000 suppliers face a big hit.

items.headline_md: **Russia extends its jet fuel export ban** to March 31, 2027, starting Dec. 1
items.summary_md: Moscow says the ban is meant to keep the domestic fuel market stable.

items.headline_md: Mobile: Hyper Surfer's **Sandy Bus: Masterpiece** breaks out at **+454K installs a week** (4.8×), and iKame's **Word Jam – Screw Puzzle** hit **No. 13** on US Top Free
items.summary_md: PlayStore Radar also lists Rockstar's **GTA: Vice City – Definitive** at +1M installs a week on Google Play (4.1×).

items.headline_md: **Monster Hunter Rise** comes to mobile through **Netflix Games**, with redesigned touch controls
items.summary_md: Quests that used to be paid or limited-time now unlock through play.

items.headline_md: Update: Silksong's free **Sea of Sorrow** expansion is dated for **Friday, Dec. 11**
items.summary_md: Team Cherry dated it during Friday's Cherry Time! showcase; all you need is the base game.

items.headline_md: **Yooka-Laylee and the Impossible Lair: Definitive Edition** is skipping Xbox and launches **Dec. 15** on PS5, Switch 2 and PC
items.summary_md: Playtonic cites "technical challenges and costs" for skipping Xbox.

items.headline_md: **Ace Combat 8** starts **Season 2** with update 1.02.000 on **Dec. 1**, adding four online missions
items.summary_md: The update also fixes campaign missions that could stall.

sections.title: Video Game Emulation
sections.body_md: **Wii U lifter watch: still not public.** u/Mindstormman's GitHub has 0 public repos, and a GitHub search for Wii U recomp/lifter repos turned up only per-game projects and homebrew. Other watch items had nothing new in the last 48h: AnyPS5 (last release v0.1.5, Nov. 11), SharpEmu (v0.0.8, Nov. 23), Kirikae, LAS Recomp, NX2navi, Boxshelf, Quiver and Nightjar. Longshot only posted nightlies. GTA VI: there's **still no confirmed playable public PC build** (E1). Reddit (r/decomps, r/emulation) blocked us today (403), so this section relies on GitHub, EmuNews, Emu Radar and news sites.

items.headline_md: Update, GTA VI: **ScarlettPort** now ships a launcher you don't have to build, but its best tester result is **22 fps**, and Portheon's "finished" claim is unverified
items.summary_md: Game Rant says ScarlettPort (v0.5.3) runs the Xbox version on Windows only into the opening area and needs game files; GameRiv reports Portheon's dev says his part is done, but there's no public build. Treat any "GTA 6 PC download" off GitHub as malware.

items.headline_md: Switch 2: **xcde-ns2-recomp v0.1.0** turns **Xenoblade Chronicles: Definitive Edition (Switch 2 Edition)** into a native Windows game
items.summary_md: Its release notes say the game plays into the story at 60 fps with real DLSS on RTX cards, from your own dump; it's the project's first release (5:49 PM CT Nov. 26).

items.headline_md: Switch 2: the **Eglantine** emulator's latest daily build **rewrites ASTC texture recompression into one pass**
items.summary_md: It packs 39 commits; the notes say this moves much less memory, with Mario Kart World as the example.

items.headline_md: **Wind Waker HD Recomp** v0.5.2 adds Japanese-version support, and v0.5.3 fixes a Windows setup error
items.summary_md: v0.5.3 (Nov. 27) stops setup failing with "data\bin is in use" when antivirus holds the new files; the game is unchanged.

items.headline_md: Xbox 360 recomps: **Guitar Hero: Metallica** and **Guitar Hero: Van Halen** reach **v1.0.0** on Windows with Steam-friends online play
items.summary_md: Both add a Mods tab and a redesigned launcher.

items.headline_md: **FinalBurn Neo** ships its first release in five years
items.summary_md: Its macOS and Linux standalone ports are no longer maintained; use the libretro cores instead.

items.headline_md: Update: **Sunrise on the Reaping** took **$11.6M on Thanksgiving Day**, second-best for the franchise, and has passed Ballad of Songbirds & Snakes' whole domestic run
items.summary_md: Its $174.9M running total beats Ballad's $166.3M lifetime; Deadline still sees an $85M five-day and about $233M by Sunday.

items.headline_md: Update: **Focker In-Law overtook Hexed on Thanksgiving**, $7.7M to $4.5M, and now looks like about **$40M** over five days versus about $35M for Disney's $200M Hexed
items.summary_md: Hexed's Thursday beat Wish's $3.8M but trailed Encanto's $5.8M.

items.headline_md: Angel's **Hershey** opened Thanksgiving Day with **$2.9M** (including previews) at 2,275 theaters, aiming for **$8M** over four days
items.summary_md: 27% of its gross so far comes from the South.

items.headline_md: Thanksgiving Day ticket sales came to about **$35.6M**, 9% below last year, and Black Friday is expected near **$59M** versus $75M a year ago
items.summary_md: Last year's Black Friday got a boost from Zootopia 2 and Wicked for Good.

items.headline_md: **Villeneuve is "deeply disappointed"** that **Avengers: Doomsday** opens against **Dune: Part Three** on Dec. 18
items.summary_md: NRG tracking has Doomsday at $270M+ (its biggest projection ever) and Dune at $75M–$80M.

items.headline_md: **Google Research** posts six math papers from **Cogentic**, an agentic discovery framework built on **Gemini 4**
items.summary_md: They cover integer factorization, game theory and graph reconstruction; the entries say there was no human input beyond the first prompt, and formal proofs come later.

items.headline_md: **SAP** is preparing to cut **at least 10,000 jobs** as it rebuilds around AI, Bloomberg reports
items.summary_md: The number isn't final and could change after labor talks.

items.headline_md: Restricted **Nvidia GB300 servers** show up in Chinese filings for a **Shanghai data center** linked to Alice Huang, Bloomberg reports
items.summary_md: Bloomberg found no evidence that Megaspeed, the Singapore firm she ran until August 2025, diverted chips.

items.headline_md: **Tencent** releases the weights and training code for **DFly2**, a draft model that speeds up text generation in Hy4
items.summary_md: Foxconn also says its 31B **FoxBrain v2.1** can run on a single qualifying AI server.

items.headline_md: **Los Angeles Unified** switches off **Google's AI Overviews** on school devices for about half a million students
items.summary_md: The district calls the block temporary (Engadget/AP).

items.headline_md: Ads: **ChatGPT ads** now report **Reach and Frequency**, so advertisers see unique people reached, not just impressions
items.summary_md: OpenAI also added a default "Learn more" link on image ads; ChatGPT ads run in 89 countries with 100,000+ advertisers.

items.headline_md: Ads: on Black Friday, **Australia and Kenya** told shoppers to set approval points before **AI shopping agents** pay for anything, and **New York banned AI companion toys**
items.summary_md: Same day: Bing brought back a buy button in shopping ads, and Google set a minimum daily budget for Demand Gen.

items.headline_md: Apple: a leaker says **Siri AI in iOS 27.3** allows **20 tokens a day** per device (10 for Image Playground); Apple hasn't confirmed
items.summary_md: Apple's own page lists only multiples: 2× on 200GB iCloud+, 5× on 2TB and 20× on 12TB.

items.headline_md: The **ITC issues import-ban orders on Samsung's Galaxy S25** over a Maxell camera patent
items.summary_md: Phones already sold are exempt; the presidential review runs to Jan. 24, 2027.

items.headline_md: **pCloud** confirms an attack on its **pCloud Pass** password manager that exposed some user emails
items.summary_md: pCloud says cloud storage wasn't touched; change a weak or reused master password now.

items.headline_md: **Wine 11.23** adds **Arm64 macOS** support and moves to vkd3d 2.2 for DirectX 12 games
items.summary_md: XDA reports it fixes some gaming bugs too.

sections.title: Markets
sections.body_md: Weekend: stock futures are closed and reopen **Sunday 5 PM CT**. The last S&P 500 E-mini trade was **7,308.25** at 12:14 PM CT Friday ([Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/ES=F/)).

items.summary_md: The S&P gained about 5.6% for the week (Yahoo closes), but the S&P and Nasdaq are still headed for their worst November since 2008 (Reuters).

items.headline_md: Chips led Friday: **Micron +7.6%**, **Marvell +7.3%**, the chip index **+4.7%**, and **Nvidia** a smaller **+0.8%**
items.summary_md: Nvidia was weak most of the day after reports that its Blackwell chips turned up at a Shanghai data center.

items.headline_md: Friday 1:44 PM CT: **gold $3,668.50** (up about 3.8% from Wednesday's settle), **WTI $83.08 (−0.7%)**
items.summary_md: Gold's official Friday settle was $3,639.60.
Both are below Friday's levels.

items.headline_md: The **10-year Treasury yield** rose to about **4.94%** from 4.85%, and traders almost fully price in a **December Fed hike**
items.summary_md: Rate-hike bets followed data showing faster Q3 growth and hotter October inflation (Reuters).

Dry today. No ice storm or tornado threat for St. Louis area in the next 7 days ([NWS St. Louis AFD](https://forecast.weather.gov/product.php?site=LSX&issuedby=LSX&product=AFD), [SPC](https://www.spc.noaa.gov/products/outlook/)). Neither city has active alerts, the NWS forecast has no snow, sleet or freezing rain, and LSX has no watches or advisories. SPC's Day 2 (Sunday) marginal severe risk covers the Southeast into the Ohio Valley, not St. Louis, and its Day 6 (Thursday) 15% area is east Texas to Mississippi/Arkansas. **Heads-up:** rain moves in after about 2 AM Sunday and lasts through Sunday. NWS St. Louis gives a >95% chance of at least 0.25 in., ~60% for 0.50 in. and ~30% for 0.75 in., with **gusts of 35–40 mph** behind the front and a Sunday-night low in the upper 20s. More showers and storms are possible Thursday into Friday.

items.headline_md: **AI labs sitting on 'bombshell' revelations that could cause global chaos, experts warn**
items.summary_md: Scott Aaronson and others explain why recent AI math proofs could soon upend the encryption that banks and governments rely on, or show it's safer than thought. It's the clearest guide yet to what the AI math wave could mean in practice.
